brief:
An Israeli drone strike on central Gaza City killed nine people, according to an ambulance official who spoke to Al Jazeera correspondents. The fatality count represents an increase from initial reports that cited six deaths from the strike.

The incident marks another attack in the densely populated enclave amid ongoing hostilities. Details about the specific location within Gaza City, the time of the strike, and the circumstances surrounding the operation remained unclear at the time of reporting.

title: Israeli drone strike kills nine in Gaza City
